Product Description

The Simple Modern Trek Tumbler is double walled and vacuum insulated to keep your drink hot or cold for hours. The cup is outfitted with an ergonomic handle, that is aesthetically designed for comfort. It comes with a straw lid and two straws so you can enjoy your favorite beverage on the go. The straw lid is four-way threaded to allow four different straw placements for your drinking hand preference. The Trek is made from 18/8 stainless steel and fits standard cupholders, and with a variety of color options, you can get an Emotional Support Water Bottle for whatever outfit or activity the day entails -- Take Us With You.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

Customers say

Customers find this tumbler to be the best they've used, with excellent temperature retention that keeps drinks cold all day, and appreciate its leak-proof design that prevents spills. The cup holder compatibility allows it to fit in various vehicle holders, and customers love its color options, with one noting it holds ice for days. Just Buy It
My new favorite mug! I was skeptical to buy stainless steel tumbler because I wasn’t a fan of Stanley. Simply Modern changed my mind about stainless steel and tumblers! Pros • No large logo • lightweight • handle is sturdy •keeps drink cold for HOURS even overnight (if kept room temperature) you will find ice!!! Cons •no alternative cap right now, would like one that is strawless and waterfall friendly but still fits tumbler •May be annoying to clean lid and if there’s a rubber ring (which I suspect there is) it will likely need replacing •have to buy additional piece to make the bottom grip and purchase extra straws too Overall, so happy and worth the research and effort and $20 I spent

    I've waited awhile before I wrote a review because I wanted to see how it held up. I've used this tumbler for over 2 months now without any problems. It isn't as tall as most 30 oz. tumblers, so when it's in the car cup holder it isn't blocking any of the controls knobs. I like that the lid screws on and the the only way it can leak is thru the straw. It keeps ice all day long. I didn't buy this for hot drinks so I can't give a honest review on how long drinks will stay hot. The 3 things I was looking for height, handle and how long ice will last and I'm happy with those 3 things. I bought this color of cup because it was a good deal. I hope they get in a better selection of colors now that I know how well I like this tumbler.

    5 out of 5 stars
    This is *IT*
    Reviewed in the United States on June 17, 2023
    Color: -Almond BirchSize: 40 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Let me start off by saying that I'm not an influencer, nor have I received anything in return for this honest review. I also gave this tumbler a solid month of daily use before I put in my 2 cents.

    Also, the pictures were taken in broad daylight. The picture of me holding it upside down is the only time it leaked, but, ya know, I'm holding it full of water, upside down, and even then, only a tiny bit escaped. Through the straw, not the lid, mind you. When the straw was removed and I held it upside down, droplets escaped, one by one.

    I didn't purchase this for any other reason than to reduce my beverage goblin tendencies, and to support my laziness in regards to washing excess dishes.

    I bought this because I was tired of having a car cup and a house cup. My house cup is my favorite, it also holds 40 oz, but doesn't fit any cup holder because it's essentially a tank (I copped it on clearance at Walmart 2 years ago for like, $6, and it's the tits). HOWEVER, it really sucks to not be able to take it everywhere, and it's definitely not spill proof. So I had that tank for the house, and my 8 year old 30 oz Yeti for the vehicle, since it fits.

    I've never used a Stanley so I cannot compare, though I do own the Simple Modern 64oz summit, had it for years, and it's stood the test of time and regular use, both outdoor and indoor. But it's not practical because, although it's very well made, it's massive, heavy, handle-less, and rolls out of the passenger seat onto the floor and out of reach, leaving me parched and annoyed.

    This tumbler is well-made, from the unit itself to the lid and straw, and the price point is beyond reasonable. I'd have paid $40 for it because of how well it's preformed.

    The handle is sturdy and comfortable, and it supports the full weight of 40 oz of ice water easily. I've dropped it several times and the powder coating hasn't chipped, nor has the metal dinged.

    Although most wouldn't think if it, it is SO nice to decide where I want the straw to be in regards to where and how I'm sitting and what hand I'm reaching for it with.

    It washes up easily.

    It's not obnoxiously large and it's overall appearance is low-key.

    It keeps my tea cold and fresh for 2 days indoors. I've left it filled with ice water in my vehicle for 2 days (in early June in the south, mind you). I got super thirsty after a grocery run and took a sip. It was room temperature, if not a skosh cool, but in no way was it warm, even though the cup itself was.

    It's fallen out of a backseat cup holder and laid on the floor for well over an hour without my knowledge, and although a few drops escaped from the straw, the carpet of my vehicle was dry, and the tumbler was still full of ice water.

    And, ya know, it keeps you hydrated because you can always keep that thang on you.

    I ordered the almond color. It's really more of a very light beige. Or coffee that's mostly creamer. A lot lighter than you'd think. It's definitely that boring popular aesthetic hue that everyone's so into, so if that's what you're going for, it's spot on.

    All in all, I really really REALLY like this tumbler and I'd definitely recommend it. Then again, Simple Modern products haven't ever really let me down, so it's not a huge shocker.

    I ordered the almond color. It's really more of a very light beige. Or coffee that's mostly creamer. A lot lighter than you'd think. It's definitely that boring popular aesthetic hue that everyone's so into, so if that's what you're going for, it's spot on.

    All in all, I really really REALLY like this tumbler and I'd definitely recommend it. Then again, Simple Modern products haven't ever really let me down, so it's not a huge shocker.

About this Item

  • Cupholder Friendly and Dishwasher Safe
  • Leak Resistant Insulated Lid: Two straws included, one color-matched and one clear Tritan plastic straw
  • Sweat-Free Exterior: Double wall insulation prevents condensation and keeps beverages hot or cold for hours
  • Durable: Made without lead, BPA and Phthalate
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty & Patent Pending

Product Description

The Simple Modern Trek Tumbler is double walled and vacuum insulated to keep your drink hot or cold for hours. The cup is outfitted with an ergonomic handle, that is aesthetically designed for comfort. It comes with a straw lid and two straws so you can enjoy your favorite beverage on the go. The straw lid is four-way threaded to allow four different straw placements for your drinking hand preference. The Trek is made from 18/8 stainless steel and fits standard cupholders, and with a variety of color options, you can get an Emotional Support Water Bottle for whatever outfit or activity the day entails -- Take Us With You.
